visual_action: A slideshow of three photos of former congressman George Santos. The first is his official portrait in front of an American flag. The second shows him in sunglasses surrounded by a media scrum. The third shows him indoors, looking agitated and pointing downwards.

cast.name: George Santos
cast.evidence: The video is a slideshow of his pictures, and the first on-screen text says 'Hi, this is George Santos!'.

cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: The on-screen text refers to being 'expelled by my own party.' As a Republican congressman, this refers to the Republican Party.

on_screen_text.text: Before I got expelled by my own party
After I got expelled by my own party

spoken_summary: A woman's voice, identified as 'Britney', says 'Hi, this is Britney, 12 hours before my show... 12 hours after my show.' This audio is recontextualized by the on-screen text to refer to George Santos' expulsion from Congress.
audio_music: A dramatic and somewhat melancholic pop track ('Shattered Glass' by HARI) plays throughout. A viral audio clip of Britney Spears speaking is layered over the music.
editing_pacing: A slow-paced slideshow featuring three static images, each displayed for a few seconds.
cultural_references: The video uses a viral audio clip from Britney Spears describing her state before and after a show. This 'before/after' audio is a well-known meme format on TikTok.
central_claim: George Santos's expulsion from Congress by his own party was a dramatic downfall that is framed as a subject for mockery using a popular meme format.
intended_effect: To mock George Santos and derive humor from his political expulsion.
